title: Understanding the Effects of Multi-Agent Deliberation for Human-AI Decision-Making
abstract: arXiv:2611.14901v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-agent deliberation (MAD), where multiple LLMs engage in structured discussion, improves AI performance on many benchmarks, but whether it helps humans make better decisions remains untested. We conduct two user studies on LLM-response-verification and fact-checking. We first compare MAD against common AI decision-support methods that isolate its two defining dimensions --- multiple AIs and multi-round interaction. We find MAD outperformed single-round AI assistance on both tasks; multi-round interaction was the main driver of this benefit, while a second AI added value when the single AI had room to improve. Then, we study two design choices in MAD --- AI persona and human engagement level --- finding a devil's advocate persona to lower accuracy and user experience, while humans' active participation in MAD improved accuracy in one task at the cost of frustration. translated_title: 理解多智能体商议对人类-AI决策的影响
translated_abstract: 多智能体商议，即多个大语言模型之间进行结构化讨论，已在许多基准测试中提升了AI的性能，但它是否有助于人类做出更好的决策仍未得到验证。我们针对LLM响应验证和事实核查开展了两项用户研究。首先，我们将MAD与常见的AI决策支持方法进行比较，这些方法分别隔离了MAD的两个核心维度——多个AI和多轮交互。我们发现，MAD在两项任务上的表现均优于单轮AI辅助；多轮交互是这一优势的主要驱动因素，而引入第二个AI仅在单个AI仍有提升空间时才能带来额外价值。随后，我们研究了MAD中的两个设计选择——AI人设和人类参与程度——发现“魔鬼代言人”（唱反调者）式的人设会降低准确性和用户体验，而人类积极参与MAD虽在一项任务中提高了准确性，但代价是带来挫败感。最后，我们讨论了关于何时、为何以及如何……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究通过两项用户实验发现，多轮AI交互是多智能体商议（MAD）提升人类决策质量的主要驱动因素，并揭示了AI人设选择与人类参与程度对决策准确性和用户体验的不同影响。
en_tdlr: Through two user studies, this research reveals that multi-round interaction is the main driver of multi-agent deliberation's (MAD) benefits for human decision-making, and shows how AI persona and human engagement level affect accuracy and user experience.
